'''Shaemal''' was the capital city of [[Coremanda]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]].

During their rebuilding after the [[Breaking of the World]], [[Ogier]] built a [[Ways|waygate]] at Shaemal.{{ref/book|6|20}} Sometime during the [[Trolloc Wars]], Shaemal was destroyed.{{ref/book|7|30}} Despite the destruction, some memories of Shaemal survive to the present age. [[Matrim Cauthon]] remembers, due to his memories from the [[Finn#Eelfinn|Eelfinn]], dancing with a [[Sea Folk]] [[Wavemistress]] in Shaemal's court before the Trolloc Wars, wearing [[Barsine]] lace and sapphire buttons from [[Aramaelle]].{{ref/book|6|5}} [[Birgitte Silverbow]] also remembers being caught spying on an Aes Sedai in the city.{{ref/book|6|12}}
